stem.en: How does the mass of a stable nucleus compare to the total mass of its separate, unbound protons and neutrons?
stem.et: Kuidas võrdub stabiilse tuuma mass tema eraldi, sidumata prootonite ja neutronite kogumassiga?

label.en: The nucleus's mass is slightly less; the missing mass, the mass defect, has been converted to the binding energy holding it together
label.et: Tuuma mass on veidi väiksem; puuduv mass, massidefekt, on teisendatud selle koos hoidvaks seoseenergiaks

label.en: The nucleus's mass is exactly equal to the sum of the separate nucleon masses
label.et: Tuuma mass on täpselt võrdne eraldi nukleonide masside summaga

label.en: The nucleus's mass is always greater, since binding adds extra mass to the system
label.et: Tuuma mass on alati suurem, kuna sidumine lisab süsteemile lisamassi

label.en: The comparison is meaningless, since protons and neutrons have no mass outside a nucleus
label.et: Võrdlus on mõttetu, kuna prootonitel ja neutronitel pole väljaspool tuuma massi
